name: Add a recurring journal
description: Adds a recurring journal, exactly as a person's Add a recurring journal does: a name, the journal's memo and lines (each an active account's code, a signed amount in the organisation's base currency, a debit above zero and a credit below, and a description; the lines must balance), whether each draft reverses on the first day of the next month (an accrual), and a schedule of every 1, 3, 6 or 12 months on a day of the month from a start date, with an optional end. The scheduler then makes a draft journal on each occurrence, which a person posts under the usual approvals: nothing recurring posts by itself. Its lines keep to income, cost, prepayment, deferred revenue and depreciation accounts; never a bank, equity, sub-ledger, tax, payroll or director's account. Its monthly equivalent, the debits over the months between occurrences, is limited. A recurring bill or invoice is a person's. Copy figures exactly as the person gave them.

name.description: What the journal is, such as Monthly rent accrual.

account.description: The code of an active account that takes postings, as records_search returned it.

amount.description: A signed decimal amount in the base currency: 250.00 for a debit, -250.00 for a credit.

reverses.description: True for an accrual that each draft reverses on the first day of the next month.

every_months.description: How often it repeats, in months.

day_of_month.description: The day of the month of each occurrence; 29 to 31 mean the last day of a shorter month.

starts_on.description: The first day it may repeat from, YYYY-MM-DD.

ends_on.description: The last day, YYYY-MM-DD; leave it out for none.
